item.title: Forms and Fighting
item.description: Fixed movement patterns, forms, are central to any martial art. You want to get better at a certain way of moving, so you focus on a movement and try to work the desired quality in isolation. If a boxer wants to get better at hitting hard, he practises his punches in isolation. Or he might practise his footwork. Forms can also be practised with a partner, maybe pad combinations involving ducking and weaving. In traditional martial arts, forms might even be at the center of the training, involving complex patterns stringed together into long sequences.
